scripts.check:contracts: npm run typecheck:contract && npm run typecheck:routing && npm run test:contract
scripts.dev:admin: npx concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tekisho/admin-api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4200/health && npm run dev:admin-ui"
scripts.dev:syntra: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,ui -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:syntra-api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4000/health && npm run dev:syntra-ui"
scripts.dev:orch-admin: npx concurrently -n orch,admin -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:orch" "node scripts/wait-ms.js 6000 && npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:full: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n syntra,orch -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:syntra" "npm run dev:orch"
scripts.dev:all:log: node scripts/tee.mjs logs/dev-all.log npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:preflight && npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --handle-input -n gateway,syntra,front,ingress,worker,authoring,ui -c gray,yellow,white,magenta,cyan,blue,green "node gateway.js" "npm run dev:syntra-api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4000/health && npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz && npm run dev:syntra-ui" "npm run dev:orch-api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4100/health && npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:admin-api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4200/health && npm run dev:admin-ui"
scripts.start:render: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n gateway,syntra,orch,worker,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta,blue,green "node gateway.js" "npm run start --prefix node-api" "npm run start -w @tekisho/api" "npm run start -w @tekisho/worker" "npm run start -w @tekisho/admin-api"
